function: Joint estimation of the target response matrix and detection of uplink QAM symbols at an ISAC base-station receiver, using an unfolded ADMM network (p. 1, 3).
system: RadCom BS with M=10 transmit, N=10 receive antennas, K=8 single-antenna uplink users, extended target; no RIS; frequency band not stated (p. 2, 4).
method: Model-driven deep unfolding of ADMM into T_ADMM layers with trainable penalty parameters; offline supervised training with a normalized error loss on the transmitted symbols (p. 3, 4).
data_channel: Own simulator: i.i.d. CN(0, I_N) user channels, Swerling II target response with random Rg; 10,000 simulated training samples; no standard or measured data (p. 2, 4).
test_conditions: Training configuration not stated (10,000 samples, 300 epochs); tests at K=8, M=N=10, L=12 and at M=N=14, L=16 with K=7-14, 4-QAM and 16-QAM (p. 4, 5).
baselines: Non-learned ZF-ZF [7] and ZFO-ZF [8]; the untrained JED-ADMM is the proposed method without learned parameters; no earlier learned receiver (p. 4).
metrics: Symbol error rate for communication, NMSE of the target response matrix for sensing, number of real-valued multiplications for complexity (p. 4).
complexity: Order O(4K^2N+8KNL+4M^2L+4MNL+T_ADMM(2Q^2KL+4K^3+8K^2L+4KL^2)); Table I: 409,605 multiplications at T_ADMM=30 versus 33,248 for ZF-ZF (p. 4).
q1_support: p. 4: "Rg is generated randomly according to [9]". The channels are the custom model of p. 2 (i.i.d. CN(0, I_N) user channels, Swerling II target); no 3GPP, DeepMIMO or measured channel is used.
q2_support: p. 4: "the model was trained for 300 epochs". The paper never states the training configuration or a test on a configuration unseen in training; Figs. 3 to 5 only list the simulation settings.
q3_support: p. 4: "compare them with existing receivers, involving ZF-ZF [7] and ZFO-ZF [8]". Both are non-learned; the untrained JED-ADMM is a variant of the proposed method; the learned receiver [9] is cited only for Rg and is not compared.
q4_support: p. 4: "the complexity is measured by the number of real-valued multiplications". Section V gives the order of JED-ADMMNet and Table I lists counts per receiver, for example 409,605 at T_ADMM = 30.
q5_support: p. 4: "training samples were generated". The data are simulated; the letter gives no link or DOI for code or data and uses no public or measured dataset.
notes: Title and DOI checked on p. 1 (JED-ADMMNet, 10.1109/LCOMM.2024.3514922). Area 1 chosen over 5: the loss uses only the symbol matrix X0 (p. 3), the headline gains are in SER (p. 5), the TRM estimate is derived from the detected symbols (p. 3), and no beams, waveforms or resources are learned (waveform S is fixed, p. 4). Reviewer may confirm against area 5 (ISAC). Table I (p. 4) was read from the page image.
